title: Evaluating Shutdown Avoidance of Language Models in Textual Scenarios
reasoning: The paper investigates 'corrigibility' and 'shutdownability' in LLMs, which are ethical properties related to an AI's willingness to comply with human interventions. It explores AI alignment with 'humanity's goals' and evaluates scenarios where AI agents might exhibit or resist ethical behaviors, such as avoiding violence or illegal activities to achieve goals.
